role: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil drafter or drafting trainee (Sydney)
subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil drafter or drafting trainee, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites people to email a CV for drafting and graduate pathways, including civil and structural drafting traineeships, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and interstate work where relocation is agreed.

Your in-house civil and structural drafting teams, and the chance to learn under senior CAD draftspeople, match the drafting start I am looking for. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid Australian role.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil drafting or drafting trainee opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
